patterns.title: Replace whole-file operations with targeted, recoverable edits.
patterns.lesson: The reusable change is the editing interface. A particular program or patch remains a task output; retention and causal effects must be checked separately.

cases.change: SICA extends whole-file overwrites with diff/range edits, input normalization and local AST navigation. These are reported updates; final-winner retention is unresolved.
DGM adds insertion, replacement, range editing and undo, then resets between attempts and replays the chosen patch.

patterns.title: Make verification a branch of the reusable program.
patterns.lesson: Compare what triggers a check, what happens on failure and whether the repaired answer is checked again. These are different control decisions.

cases.change: TTHE keeps a cheap solve path and invokes verification and repair after exposed public-test failures.
AFlow’s MBPP workflow generates three candidates, selects one, tests it and sends failures to a repair prompt. Its listing returns the repaired candidate without a further test call.
MermaidFlow’s HumanEval crossover inherits a testing node from one parent and a more diverse ensemble from the other; the illustrated child is not automatically the final winner.

patterns.title: Give repository edits a smaller and more precise interface.
patterns.lesson: Local reads, structured editing and targeted initial retrieval address different sources of wasted repository context.

cases.change: DGM adds line-range views and unique-string replacement to its whole-file starting interface.
SICA evolves diff/range editing and targeted AST operations around its inherited context manager.
A Mixture candidate ranks files from issue identifiers and injects bounded source/test content before the first action. Structured replacement is already present in its parent.

patterns.title: Keep long tool returns from exhausting the working context.
patterns.lesson: Information reduction needs a way to obtain missing detail again. Full-version recovery results do not isolate the compression rule.

cases.change: Multi-task Self-Harness caps very long outputs at their head and tail and shortens older returns. Its selected version solves 7 of 12 SWE-Bench Pro tasks where the seed hits the input limit; this is not a SWE-bench Verified result.

change_by_benchmark.swe-bench-verified: Multi-task Self-Harness’s bounded-output version is transferred unchanged to 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks. This evaluates reuse of the complete harness; the 7-of-12 overflow-recovery example belongs to SWE-Bench Pro.
change_by_benchmark.deepswe: The same Multi-task Self-Harness lineage is transferred unchanged to 53 DeepSWE tasks. The record provides no second concrete DeepSWE lineage or isolated effect of output trimming.

cases.change: SICA reduces returned diff context and parses only relevant code regions, rather than processing every entire file.

patterns.title: Route patch failures to the right kind of recovery.
patterns.lesson: An empty diff, a dependency error and a failing assertion call for different actions. Instructions that request a check are distinct from code that enforces it.

cases.change: DGM rejects empty, unparsable or heuristic test-only patches; it resets the workspace, explains the failure and allows another attempt.
TTHE reruns an empty-patch attempt with reproduce–localize–repair–retest guidance and a larger budget.
Self-Harness’s GLM instructions separate missing-package recovery from source debugging. In its paired Astropy case, dependency repair enables all four previously failing tests to pass.
RHO adds an executed helper for toolchain discovery, lightweight language checks and custom verification commands.
OneRecipe injects language-specific compilation/testing reminders when recent activity suggests testing or submission.
CODESKILL’s reusable Maven guidance separates environment, configuration and dependency failures and checks a missing test-jar before retrying.

patterns.title: Turn a repair example into conditional guidance.
patterns.lesson: The reusable artifact is a rule about responsibility, interfaces or failure conditions—not a remembered patch to one repository.

cases.change: HarnessCompass retains guidance for tracing responsibility along execution paths and checking affected callers of shared interfaces.
GSE consolidates project-specific rules into distinctions such as value-triggered versus state-triggered defects.
SkillForge’s Django guidance uses the existing Decimal pipeline and precision-dependent equivalence instead of a narrow exponent heuristic.

patterns.title: Repair the connection between a tool call and its payload.
patterns.lesson: Before adding more reasoning, check whether the intended action reaches the correct tool unchanged. The detailed Go case is external to Terminal-Bench.

cases.change: ModularRSI reports command-name dispatch that preserves multiline file contents instead of sending them to the shell. Mean steps drop 36 → 25 in its external Go case; concurrent edits and incomplete historical artifacts limit attribution.

patterns.title: Check completion without destroying or repeatedly rechecking it.
patterns.lesson: Delivery rules need a trigger and a stopping condition. Paired mechanisms, advisory skills and executable guards provide different evidence.

cases.change: AHE hardens a destructive-action guard and surfaces its warning before the next action. The configure-git-webserver case changes from 0/2 to 2/2 successful rollouts after the paired edits.
Self-Harness adds early artifact creation and model-specific limits or error-triggered middleware.
A Mixture candidate uses a persistent one-time flag so later completion signals do not reopen the same verification request.
RRSI accepts bounded completion-audit and nonblocking-polling guidance together in R0-A; final retention is unknown.
DarwinX retains a bundle of skills for explicit acceptance conditions, artifact checks and rechecking after changes.
RHO’s terminal playbook checks requirements and container-side paths. Its generated terminal scripts are not executed in the reported trajectories.

patterns.title: Put environment state where the next action can use it.
patterns.lesson: Bootstrap observations and later context reduction solve different visibility problems; the scope of each source remains separate.

cases.change: Meta-Harness injects a bounded environment snapshot before the first model call; the timeout and silent failure keep the probe from blocking execution.
Multi-task Self-Harness bounds tool returns, preserves opening/recent history and starts a fresh-context filesystem review at the first stop decision.

patterns.title: Evolve how experiments are run and represented.
patterns.lesson: These are complementary ML cases, not multiple demonstrations of one common algorithm. The produced model is distinct from the persistent experiment harness.

cases.change: AIDE² evolves strategy arms, cross-arm forks, bounded experiment summaries and recurring-error signatures. MLE-bench Lite22 evaluates frozen transfer; it never participates in evolutionary selection.
SIA adds a batched MAGIC configuration driver and a parser returning parameter–score pairs; final code retention and per-tool effects are unconfirmed.
AIBuildAI-2 turns working directories into categorized takeaways and revises retrieval pointers; a complete evaluated before/after document is not provided.
DisCo revises competition-specific operational guidance from diagnostic runs, then freezes it around a fixed Codex controller.

patterns.title: Decide what gets checked before a numerical answer is returned.
patterns.lesson: Intermediate-representation review and candidate-solution checks operate at different points. More calls are not independently validated improvements.

cases.change: ADAS’s documented example reviews and revises a problem representation before final reasoning; its name does not establish visual input processing.
AFlow generates five GSM8K solutions, selects one and performs computational review with a fallback.
MermaidFlow generates computational candidates before selection as well, then refines and formats the chosen answer.

patterns.title: Match mathematical diversity to a concrete checking procedure.
patterns.lesson: A reusable solution pipeline specifies how candidates differ and how disagreement is resolved; it is not just an instruction to think longer.

cases.change: AFlow’s selected MATH program combines a rewritten program output with three textual alternatives.
MermaidFlow combines five distinct solver/outline responses with a programmatic result, then refines the selection; the operator family is related to AFlow.
A Mixture candidate separates constructive answers from necessary conditions and handles agreement with a challenge, disagreement with a concrete check.
WDA selects model-specific two- or three-stage pipelines. These are fixed pipelines, not per-question adaptive depth.

patterns.title: Change the evidence or runtime at the observed mathematical bottleneck.
patterns.lesson: Model-dependent recovery, retrieval and co-training are not interchangeable sources of a gain.

cases.change: Meta-Harness routes example retrieval by mathematical subject, with contrasting treatments for combinatorics, geometry and number theory.
Co-Harness repairs interpreter launch/cleanup, batches inference and restores thinking on follow-up turns before ensembling; inconsistent counts/times limit quantitative interpretation.
HarnessBank disables runaway thinking for one backbone but increases reasoning for another; the full Qwen stack rises from 54.3% to 66.0% on its test setting.
WHALE’s effective tool use appears in a co-evolved model–harness pair. The trace does not identify a harness-only cause.

patterns.title: Preserve checker-usable proof state and repair locally.
patterns.lesson: The interface can improve even while a richer proof plan fails. New tools are useful only if their outputs remain valid in the active proof context.

cases.change: Self-modifying Lean agents add bounded compiler repair and checked lemma names; a richer auxiliary-lemma branch fails to outperform the simpler winning repair route.
RSI-Exam optimizer runs fix nested-proof extraction and revise diagnostics under fixed call/check budgets; visible checkpoint improvements are not hidden-test results.
The evolved Rocq interface adds persistent sessions, rollback and bounded candidate trials. A heavily used lemma-search tool is rejected without an accuracy gain.

patterns.title: Retrieve evidence that distinguishes competing labels.
patterns.lesson: These mechanisms distinguish competing labels through contrasting examples or task-specific discriminator guidance. A shared classifier evaluated twice is one artifact, not two discoveries.

cases.change: Meta-Harness explores same-label confirmers versus competing-label challengers and a separate one-call label-coverage program.
MCE’s legal context decomposes acts and adds warnings for multiple-act cases; its context-engineer skill is a separate optimizer-side object.
Task-CoEvolve combines word/character retrieval and discounts already-covered labels.
Meta-Harness reuses its classification frontier on symptom descriptions; the legal and symptom records are not independent discoveries.
MCE retrieves relevant discriminator sections for symptom patterns and falls back to its full guide when no condition matches.
Task-CoEvolve’s shared classifier balances lexical matching with label coverage on Symptom2Disease.
HASE revises lexical retrieval and label-grouped memory, alongside model-weight updates; the complete gain is not harness-only.

patterns.title: Change how a question reaches relevant stored evidence.
patterns.lesson: Separate the inherited memory architecture from the methods actually revised. Procedure ablations and fixed-checkpoint edit tests answer different questions.

cases.change: EvolveMem activates dormant name-stripped retrieval and multi-hop decomposition and adds low-confidence verification.
MemCodex rewrites construction, indexing, retrieval and routing within an existing hierarchy; adaptive depth is already part of the seed.

patterns.title: Fix the statistic and operands before calculating.
patterns.lesson: This is a documented OfficeQA skill example, not an established multi-paper pattern or an enforced runtime gate.

cases.change: HarnessEvolve expands financial-metrics guidance to distinguish share changes from growth rates, specify denominators and verify constants/revisions against the corpus.

patterns.title: Keep web experience usable after the original task.
patterns.lesson: Memory-program changes and task-runner edits address different parts of web work. Transductive scores and answer exposure must stay visible.

cases.change: MemEvolve’s Cerebra distills reusable tools/knowledge and maintains working memory; WebWalkerQA and xBench test transfer from TaskCraft.
HarnessX ships prompt, processor, configuration and tool revisions for blocked sources and reasoning/parsing failures.
LiteEvo selects composed prompt/processor changes, but its GAIA report documents answer-copy exposure; the score is not clean unseen-question evidence.

patterns.title: Bind browser actions to the intended object and navigation state.
patterns.lesson: Executable selectors and advisory web procedures are different artifacts; an unused added tool is not evidence of a successful capability.

cases.change: SkillWeaver replaces a global textbox selector with a deletion-dialog-scoped textbox and confirmation button.
Evo-Harness compiles web feedback into reusable task-type procedures, including auto-label and email-handling instructions.
HarnessX reduces search/pagination loops with prompt/configuration changes. Its color-matching tool has zero measured hit-rate.

patterns.title: Make action prerequisites explicit in service workflows.
patterns.lesson: Check what runs before an action, rather than assuming that adding a tool repairs the workflow.

cases.change: LiteEvo adds login/credential guidance and repeats login steps after two authorization errors. AppWorld’s 67.7% full-harness pass@2 versus 63.1% prompt-only is a bundle comparison.
HarnessX ships ordering and premature-action rules for τ³-Bench; no tool edits ship in the reported service runs.
ScholarEvolve selects benchmark/backbone-specific combinations of tool-interface, context, skill and reasoning modules; their source-method names denote provenance.

patterns.title: Turn game state into executable admissibility and value checks.
patterns.lesson: Synthesized checks belong to the evolved harness; a supplied retry loop does not. A game-specific policy is not automatically a general playing strategy.

cases.change: AutoHarness synthesizes legality functions around an existing action/retry loop, including chess-coordinate and attack-detection logic.
DemoEvolve’s Liar’s Dice variant parses state, computes claim probabilities and legal raises, and switches to calling when its expected-value margin warrants it. That case is not a Balatro mechanism.

patterns.title: Recover using the observed geometry and grasp state.
patterns.lesson: Reuse depends on observable failure states and available corrective actions. Frozen related-task transfer supports the complete stack, not every branch.

cases.change: Zetta adds bounded regrasp, failed-grasp memory, stability checks and support-before-release. Its unchanged stack averages 64% → 84% on three related placement tasks.
HarnessPAI corrects basket targeting using upper-rim medians with a sparse-point fallback, keeping the placement servo unchanged.
Recursive Harness Distillation revises intervention guidance for occlusion, weak/empty grasps and support checks; teacher-guided and self-refined playbooks produce different outcomes.

patterns.title: Make commands and context match the fixed robot actor.
patterns.lesson: A high-level planner can change without changing low-level policy weights. This record supports one concrete implementation.

cases.change: SHAPER emits exact entity names and actor-compatible primitives, emphasizes current images/recent state, compresses old rounds and exposes stagnation.

patterns.title: Preserve the link between visual claims and observations.
patterns.lesson: Fewer inspected frames are not automatically lower total compute. Search trajectories alone do not reveal a final sampling rule.

cases.change: Video-RSI adds frame-linked findings, uncertainty, relations over existing observations and duplicate-aware occurrence counting; its deployed graph queries consume no new frames.

patterns.title: Recheck temporal boundaries without assuming extra calls will fix them.
patterns.lesson: One source supplies both a positive case and a persistent regression. This is evidence of a conditional trade-off, not a universal improvement.

cases.change: VideoEvolve uses the same 64 frames, conditionally makes more predictions and aggregates endpoints by medians. A kettle interval improves; the light-switch error persists with additional calls.

patterns.title: Encode reference and composition failures in reusable procedures.
patterns.lesson: Selection logic, skill documents and localized policy changes are different persistent artifacts. A generated image itself is not the harness.

cases.change: AutoRef binds references, produces subject-/background-led drafts and applies failure-aware, order-swapped selection. Replacing the combined selector lowers the MultiBanana four-reference held-out average 7.37 → 6.93 at a fixed three-image budget.

change_by_benchmark.omnicontext: AutoRef binds prompt elements to references, generates complementary drafts and selects against hard failures and presentation-order effects. The quoted 7.37 → 6.93 selector ablation belongs to MultiBanana, not OmniContext.

cases.change: COMFYCLAW learns reusable spatial/count and attribute-binding skills; its verifier and rollback tools are supplied architecture.
EvoGen-Harness illustrates localized counting, spatial, attribute and action–object changes; illustrative possible patches are not exact retained diffs.

patterns.title: Retain a production procedure across stories or categories.
patterns.lesson: The papers specify persistent policy/skill updates more clearly than every final instruction diff. Coverage should not be mistaken for a fully extracted common recipe.

cases.change: VideoWeaver revises reusable composition skills and their creator instructions, freezes skills for held-out cases and merges creators for unseen categories.
CineForge admits stage-local textual policy changes using replay; read-only checkpoint evaluation and a fixed audit reviewer separate testing from adaptation.
